currentState.architecture: New React 18+ application with TypeScript, Vite build, Jotai state management (NO useState), Three.js 3D globe, i18n (10 languages), dark/light theme

criticalConstraints: JOTAI ATOMS ONLY - Absolutely NO useState anywhere in the codebase
Every component must be responsive from 200px to 3000px width
CSS modules for all component styles to prevent conflicts
All UI text must be translatable via i18next
Dark and light theme support with CSS custom properties
Each task owns unique files - no cross-task file editing

parallelizationStrategy: All 40 tasks are fully independent with unique file ownership. Each task creates its own components/atoms/utilities without modifying files from other tasks. Tasks can be executed in any order or simultaneously. No cross-task file editing. Components use Jotai atoms for state (NO useState anywhere).
criticalImplementationNotes: ABSOLUTELY NO useState ANYWHERE - All state MUST use Jotai atoms
Every single component must be tested at 200px, 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px, 2560px, 3000px widths
Use CSS clamp() for all font sizes: clamp(minSize, preferredSize, maxSize)
Use container queries (@container) in addition to media queries where appropriate
All text content must use i18next t() function - no hardcoded strings
CSS custom properties must support both dark and light themes
Each component uses CSS modules (.module.css) to prevent style conflicts
Three.js Canvas must be responsive and handle window resize
Country data includes accurate ISO codes and coordinates for globe positioning
Price calculations must handle multiple currencies and tax rates
All tasks are 100% independent - can run in parallel without conflicts
Each task owns exclusive files - no cross-task editing
Components can use existing project utilities but NOT step-created components

atomTypes: async atoms (if API needed in future)
